checked: Student paragraphs stay within three sentences. The single four-item list groups statutory clauses; worked solutions use numbered lists.

The effects-map placeholder names its center, three branches, and examples. The agency placeholder separates complaint handling from trial. The classroom chain specifies all boxes and arrow labels. Surrounding prose remains understandable without images.

Corruption, direct bribery, graft conditions, confidential information, plunder, kickback, red tape, fixer, accountability, SALN, impeachment, and Citizen's Charter receive meanings before examples require them. The lesson supplies its own reminders of public interest, simple living, and the gift exception.

The lesson connects office misuse to private gain, spells out selected statutory forms, explains the amended plunder threshold, and traces social, economic, and political harms. It explains how complaint handling, sworn wealth disclosure, and posted processes support accountability.

The teaching limits bribery to an accepted exchange rather than a rejected offer; distinguishes the grounds and fault conditions of RA 3019; and separates the purpose requirement of RA 6713 information misuse.

Plunder needs covered acts and the fifty-million threshold. Processing teaching includes completeness, applicable fees, extension notice, pauses, and separate council timing. Gift teaching requires unsolicited insignificant value and no favor. Delays and honest mistakes alone are not treated as proof of corruption.
